{{Top|leg}}
'''Phage Network''' was a communications network which was attacked by [[Slicer/Legends|slicers]] some time before [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]]. A renegade programmer named [[Izhsmash]] was rumored to be the developer of the original cryptoviral code used during the attack.
